title: rAAV-mediated multi-miRNA delivery targeting MAPK pathway suppresses laser-induced choroidal neovascularization in mice.
snippet: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss, with neovascular AMD (nAMD) characterized by choroidal neovascularization (CNV) and subretinal fibrosis.
